author: Cptnwhizbang
body: Skills use either your attack or magic stat to calculate damage. If you use a hybrid amity, instead of calculating using only your attack or magic stat it averages them, though you still need to use either gunnr for most skills or snotra for most spells as before. For example, spiked shield used attack but is often paired with a hybrid amity. If I choose to go hybrid I'd still only use gunnr and not snotra to boost that attack. It's well worth the damage if you don't mind losing the associated defensive stats.
